dataSafety.title: Data Safety
dataSafety.intro: We handle your account information and adoption activity with care. This page explains what Floofs stores, why we store it, and the choices you have.

account.title: Your account
account.body: We store your name, email address, password hash, account role, and optional phone number so you can sign in, manage your profile, and use Floofs securely.

data.title: Your listings and conversations
data.body: Pet listings, photos, and messages are stored to make adoption connections possible. Messages are designed to remain private to the participants in each conversation.

security.title: Keeping information safe
security.body: Passwords are stored as hashes, verification links expire, and we use access controls to limit account information to the people and services that need it.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can update your profile, change your email address or password, remove optional contact information, and permanently delete your account from Settings.
